summary: The native Android release build allows plain ws:// only to loopback (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1). The emulator host 10.0.2.2 is debug only, because on a real phone it is a LAN address.

desktop.reason: The desktop does not dial phones; its ws:// and wss:// endpoint is unchanged.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app keeps its own transport gate (src/shared/transport-security.ts) and is not the Play upload; this change is the native Android network security config only.

sharedBackendApi.reason: The wire protocol, the QR payload and the server's ws:// and wss:// endpoint are unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: Saved machines are not rewritten. A saved ws://10.0.2.2 machine in a release build is refused at dial time with the existing re-pair message.

updateRelease.reason: Package, signing and the Play upload workflow are unchanged; the release AAB simply carries the stricter config.

automated: gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest ConnectionDecisionsTest and NativeConnectionTargetResolverTest: release refuses a saved ws://10.0.2.2 machine, debug allows it, [::1] is loopback.
gradle :app:lintDebug and :app:lintRelease pass with ::1 in the release network security config.
apps/android/contract-tests/scaffold_contract_test.sh fails when the release config names 10.0.2.2.
notExercised: No physical phone or emulator was run; the platform enforcement of the network security config was not exercised on a device.
